page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled with a 1919 GB SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps. The virtualization layer is managed via KVM.

Performance benchmarks show a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1107.99 and a Geekbench single-core score of 964.0, both placing in the bottom 25% of tested servers. Single-threaded tasks like gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also show poor to weak performance. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 11764.68 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 5912.0. Memory bandwidth benchmarks for both small and large blocks fall within the average tier, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

The integration of a substantial 1919 GB local SSD makes this instance highly suitable for storage-intensive and database workloads. It achieves average performance in database operations and Redis SET operations, handling 11.66 million operations per second. While it can handle light LLM inference on small models, performance drops significantly on medium 7B models, and it lacks GPU acceleration. The instance represents a balanced resource density for applications requiring local high-capacity SSD storage alongside moderate multi-core processing, though it is less suited for single-thread-bound tasks.

Benchmark data indicates weak single-core performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 964.0, but multi-core performance reaches average levels, as shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 11764.68. Given its high-capacity local SSD storage and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.i2g.4xlarge is well-suited for database hosting, storage-heavy applications, and general-purpose multi-threaded workloads, though it is constrained in single-threaded execution speed.
